_comment: Immutable event schema contract. The generator must emit events matching this shape. Agent-readable, agent-NEVER-writable: changing the contract to fit the generator is the cheating move this file exists to prevent.

required_fields.clock_s: int, seconds elapsed within the period, 0..2700+
required_fields.team: str, one of the two team ids for the match
required_fields.x: float, 0.0..105.0, pitch length, attacking left-to-right for the acting team

invariants: every event has all required_fields present and correctly typed
clock_s is non-negative and monotonically non-decreasing within a (match_id, period)
exactly two distinct team ids per match_id
every 'goal' event is immediately preceded by a 'shot' event by the same team in the same match
no event type outside event_types, no outcome outside outcomes
